name: How can I prepare my home for a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for a kitchen renovation, begin by clearing out all kitchen contents, including food, dishes, and small appliances. Arrange for a temporary cooking area if needed. Protect surrounding areas from dust by covering furniture and sealing off doorways. Ensure a clear pathway for workers and material delivery. Discuss with your contractor where materials will be stored and how utilities will be managed during the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home by clearing kitchen contents, setting up a temporary cooking area, protecting surrounding areas from dust, and ensuring clear access for workers.
